notes.title: We need your help!
notes.content:
As you may know, we are a small indie studio dedicated to doing our best.

Our first game, Hentai Beauties, is proof of this. Each character in the game was designed and animated with great care and attention to detail. We’re eager to keep creating [b]even better games![/b]

To achieve this goal, we need your help. If you enjoyed Hentai Beauties, [b]leaving a review would mean a lot to us.[/b] It's a small gesture that would make a big difference for us.

We promise to keep doing our best to create more high-quality games for you to enjoy. Thank you for your support!
